The '''Ivory Gatekeeper''' is an NPC in [[Somnoire]] that first appears in the [[Depths of Illusive Realm]] event and the enemy of the [[Ebony Gatekeeper]].

He also takes on the form of the [[Strange White Cat]] and provides [[Depths of Illusive Realm/Metaphors|Metaphors]] for the player.
